articles.title: Replit is no longer working with Anthropic, CEO says
articles.description: Masad said the decision was made for a number of different reasons, including cost. Replit announced a partnership with OpenAI in August, but there was never any indication that it was no longer with Anthropic.
articles.author: Lucas Ropek

articles.title: Elorian’s first AI model wants to reason with images, not just about them
articles.description: According to Elorian's evaluations, Glimpse outperforms even GPT-6 Astra on scientific chart reasoning and short-form video captioning, with competitive results on other visual reasoning tasks.
articles.author: Aditya Mehta

articles.title: India becomes the latest country to report rogue AI agent activity
articles.description: The agents got in through credentials and connection settings left exposed in app configurations, public code repositories, and overly permissive cloud roles.
articles.author: Aditya Mehta

articles.title: Physical AI is more than robots, says the Nvidia veteran now investing in it
articles.description: Techable VC founder and former Nvidia exec Amulya Vishwanath tells Equity why robotics’ ChatGPT moment can wait, and why the real opportunity is rebuilding its basic building blocks.

articles.title: An Nvidia insider-turned-VC on why robotics hasn’t hit its ChatGPT moment, yet
articles.description: Watch as Techable VC founder and former Nvidia exec Amulya Vishwanath tells Equity why robotics’ ChatGPT moment can wait, and why the real opportunity is rebuilding its basic building blocks.

articles.title: Jev is Vercel’s fastest-adopted AI model ever
articles.description: The data comes from Vercel's AI gateway, a unified API service similar to OpenRouter.
articles.author: Russell Brandom

articles.title: Mark Wahlberg on using AI in film ‘the right way’ and being open to an AI clone carrying on his legacy
articles.description: Actor and angel investor Mark Wahlberg says he's OK with using AI in filmmaking, provided it's used "to enhance what you're doing."
articles.author: Aisha Malik

articles.title: Veritas expands its anti-counterfeit chip to jewelry, trophies, and fragrance bottles
articles.description: Counterfeiters are getting better at replicating brands' marks and passing off dupes, known as "superfakes," as genuine items. A startup called Veritas wants to tackle the problem with its own chip that verifies goods.
articles.author: Ivan Mehta

articles.title: Replit’s CEO says the future of work is the ‘self-driving company’
articles.description: Replit CEO Amjad Masad envisions a future of “self-driving companies,” where AI agents handle day-to-day tasks and people focus on higher-level decisions.
articles.author: Sarah Perez
